_comment: Transport is inferred per entry: 'command' = local stdio process, 'url' = remote HTTP/SSE. ${VAR} in a url or header value is read from the environment toolsieve runs in; if it is unset, that one server fails with an error naming the variable, never a silent unauthenticated request and never at the expense of your other servers. Keep tokens in your shell profile, not in this file.
